svg.aria-label: A self-playing terminal session answering: who is Mirang? Mirang Bhandari builds offline AI apps and AI agents. Built so far: MindWell, mcpay, TenderFlow, HDR2SDR. Right now: an MSc in Applied Data Science & AI at SRH Heidelberg, AI/ML research at Deutsche Bank, learning Rust, and offline desktop apps. Fluent in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, React, LangGraph, MCP and Ollama.
